varAccountId.title: varAccountId
varAccountId.description: Returns the unique identifiers of the customer account used to retrive the support ticket

varActionMessage.title: varActionMessage
varActionMessage.description: Displays the final message indicating ticket priority and actions taken by the system.

varAssignedTo.title: varAssignedTo
varAssignedTo.description: Indicates the support agent or team assigned to handle the ticket.

varPriorityLevel.title: varPriorityLevel
varPriorityLevel.description: Represents the calculated ticket priority level (High, Medium, Low) based on issue description.

varTicketId.title: varTicketId
varTicketId.description: Returns the unique identifier of the support ticket analyzed by the system.
